# Tab & Tally

> Free tools for groups at tabandtally.co.uk: split bills, Secret Santa, whip-rounds, scoreboards, killer pool, sweepstakes, quiz scoring and league tables. Each tool uses one shareable code, needs no sign-up, never holds or moves money, and is paid for by adverts. Groups are deleted automatically after 30 days, or 3 months if the organiser chooses.

## Tools

- [QuidsIn](https://tabandtally.co.uk/quidsin/): bill splitter that shows who owes whom and the fewest payments to settle up.
- [Secret Santa](https://tabandtally.co.uk/santa/): online name draw. Everyone sees only their own match; the organiser sees none. Optional wishlists.
- [Whip-round](https://tabandtally.co.uk/whipround/): collect for a gift or leaving do and track who has paid. Never handles the money.
- [Tally](https://tabandtally.co.uk/tally/): live shared scoreboard for game nights, pool, darts and quizzes.
- [Killer Pool](https://tabandtally.co.uk/killerpool/): tracker for pub killer and own-ball killer with lives, re-rack payer and final shot options.
- [Pickers](https://tabandtally.co.uk/pickers/): random name picker, fair team splitter, order shuffle, coin flip and dice. Runs in the browser; nothing is saved.
- [Sweepstake](https://tabandtally.co.uk/sweepstake/): fair random draw of teams, horses or numbers to people, for the World Cup, Grand National or office games.
- [Quiz night](https://tabandtally.co.uk/quiz/): round-by-round quiz scoring with a live leaderboard.
- [League](https://tabandtally.co.uk/league/): league table that works itself out from entered results, with optional generated fixtures.

## Guides

- [Secret Santa generator with no sign-up](https://tabandtally.co.uk/secret-santa-generator/): Run a Secret Santa online for free. How it works, what budget to set, and how to keep matches secret, even from the organiser. No sign-up or emails.
- [Sweepstake generator for tournaments, races and the office](https://tabandtally.co.uk/sweepstake-generator/): Free sweepstake generator. Draw teams, horses or numbers to people fairly, share the result, and track who is still in. Ideas for the World Cup, Euros, Grand National and the office.
- [Pub quiz scorer with a live leaderboard](https://tabandtally.co.uk/pub-quiz-scorer/): Free pub quiz scorer. Enter team scores after each round and share a live leaderboard. Half points, extra rounds and late teams all supported. No sign-up.
- [Killer pool rules: pub killer and own-ball killer](https://tabandtally.co.uk/killer-pool-rules/): How to play killer pool. Rules for pub killer and own-ball killer, lives, becoming a killer, who pays for the re-rack, the final shot, and a free tracker.
- [League table maker with fixtures](https://tabandtally.co.uk/league-table-maker/): Free league table maker. Add the teams, generate fixtures, enter results and the table works itself out. For pool, darts, quizzes and five-a-side leagues.
- [How to split bills with friends and flatmates](https://tabandtally.co.uk/split-bills-with-friends/): How to split shared expenses without arguments. Keep a running list, see who owes whom, and settle up with the fewest payments. Free, no sign-up.
- [How to run a whip-round for a gift or leaving do](https://tabandtally.co.uk/whip-round-for-a-gift/): How to run a whip-round for a leaving gift, wedding present or group card. Set a target, share one link and see who has chipped in. We never hold your money.
- [Random team generator and name picker](https://tabandtally.co.uk/random-team-generator/): Free random team generator. Split a list of names into fair teams, pick a name from a hat, shuffle an order or flip a coin. Runs on your phone, saves nothing.
